label: PowerEdge R450 1U rack server
description: 1U single-socket rack server with two 1GbE LOM ports on the motherboard and a separate dedicated 1GbE iDRAC9 port. One OCP 3.0 mezzanine slot and two PCIe Gen4 slots take any additional network card.
notes: Onboard: 2x 1GbE LOM only (no 10G copper on the board). OCP 3.0 mezzanine slot is empty in the base config - that is where a 10/25GbE card goes; 2x PCIe Gen4 slots for stand-up cards. The iDRAC9 port is a physically separate management network, not shared with LOM1.
